title: Governing Enterprise AI Traffic at Scale: Design and Operation of a Policy-Driven, Multi-Vendor LLM Gateway on Envoy
abstract: arXiv:2610.35509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol and pricing. Integrated directly, this heterogeneity yields credential sprawl, format lock-in, unbounded spend and inconsistent governance. We present the design and production operation of the Cosmos LLM Gateway, the governed entry point for enterprise LLM traffic at PayPal. Built on Envoy, it splits work by latency profile: I/O-bound control decisions (authentication, credential brokering, policy and budget evaluation) run in an out-of-process external-processing service, while wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping run in-proxy as a Rust WebAssembly filter, so that, by default, streamed response body chunks never wait on an out-of-process call. Models, providers and prices are largely validated data rather than code. Governance is declarative policy evalu

translated_title: 大规模企业AI流量的治理：基于Envoy的策略驱动多厂商LLM网关的设计与运营
translated_abstract: 大型组织同时使用来自多个厂商的大语言模型（LLM），而每个厂商都有各自不同的API方言、凭证模型、流式传输协议和定价方式。如果直接集成，这种异构性会导致凭证泛滥、格式锁定、无节制的支出以及不一致的治理。我们介绍了Cosmos LLM网关的设计与生产运营情况，它是PayPal企业LLM流量的受治理统一入口。该网关构建于Envoy之上，按延迟特征划分工作负载：I/O密集型的控制决策（认证、凭证代理、策略与预算评估）在进程外的外部处理服务中运行，而线上格式转换、token计量和提示缓存整形则以Rust WebAssembly过滤器的形式在代理内运行，因此默认情况下，流式响应体分块永远不会因进程外调用而等待。模型、提供商和价格在很大程度上是经过验证的数据而非代码。治理采用声明式策略评估机制。
tldr: PayPal的Cosmos LLM网关基于Envoy，通过将I/O密集型控制决策（进程外服务）与数据面转换（代理内Rust WASM过滤器）按延迟特征分离，实现了对多厂商企业LLM流量的统一策略治理、成本控制与无缝流式转发。
en_tdlr: PayPal's Cosmos LLM Gateway built on Envoy separates I/O-bound control decisions (out-of-process services) from data-plane translation (in-proxy Rust WASM filters) by latency profile, enabling unified policy governance, cost control, and seamless streaming for multi-vendor enterprise LLM traffic.
